item.title: cobaltcore-dev/aurora-dashboard - @cobaltcore-dev/aurora@2.5.0
item.description:
Minor Changes

  • 7e7f705: Add Neutron Networks management (BFF and read-only UI)
- Add network.networks tRPC BFF: list (the project's own networks and the networks shared with it, merged by ID and returned in full), getById, create, update, delete, setTags, listSubnets and listPorts - list, listSubnets and listPorts follow Neutron's pagination links so the full collection is returned even when pagination_max_limit is configured - Map network-specific Neutron errors (e.g. ports still in use on delete, sharing still in use, admin-only attributes, quota exceeded) to clear messages - Add a "Networks" entry under Network in the side navigation and a "Networks" card on the project overview; both require networks in enabledServices - Add a Networks list view (Status, Name / ID, Admin State, Subnets, Shared, External) whose search (name and ID), status/shared/external filters and sorting all run client-side over a single list response (no pagination); the subnet count comes from each network's embedded subnets array; status values are displayed in title case (e.g. "Active") - Add a network details view with copy-to-clipboard for IDs, a Subnets tab, a Ports tab and a Routers tab - Ports tab: lists all ports on the network (ID, Status, Admin State, Fixed IPs, MAC Address, Device Owner, Attached Device) - Routers tab: derives the set of attached routers from network:router_interface ports (deduplicated); each router ID deep-links to the router detail view (with a copy affordance beside it) when the Routers scope is available in the catalog, and degrades to a plain copy affordance otherwise

Patch Changes

  • d91f83e: - Guard service-extension routes so a disabled extension cannot be reached by navigating directly to its URL
- The /projects/$projectId/services/$serviceType route now enforces the same visibility rules the side nav and project home page use: it honors the enabledServices allow list and deniedServices deny list, and verifies the extension's serviceType/serviceName against the project's OpenStack catalog - A disabled or catalog-absent extension redirects to the project home page; an unknown serviceType continues to return not-found
  • 27a532b: - Remove the image column from the Instances list; image name and id are shown on the instance detail view only
  • 839fa7b: Key Manager UX improvements — validation, labels, and empty-state polish
- Add live character counters and maxLength to all limited text fields in Create Secret, Create Container, and Create Order modals (255 chars for name/algorithm/mode, 10,000 bytes for payload) - Show validation error immediately on input when a field reaches its limit and disable the Create button while any error is present - Add min=1 validation to the Bit Length field in Create Secret modal - Convert Payload Content Type in Create Order modal from a free text field to a Select with fixed options, hidden for the asymmetric order type - Rename secrets list column headers to "Type" (secret type) and "Payload Content Type" (content type) - Add a Created column to the secrets list and rename the sort label from "Created At" to "Created" - Replace the unnamed placeholder with "- -" across all Key Manager list rows and the Container detail view - Remove "Optional." prefix from name field helptext in Create Container and Create Order modals - Move the container type description into the Type Select's helptext
  • a7f6f43: - Make private_key_passphrase optional when creating an RSA container (Barbican requires only private_key and public_key)
- Show a warning in the Delete Order modal when the order is still in PENDING state to prevent orphaned Barbican resources - Make secret-ref rows in the Container detail view clickable, navigating directly to the secret detail page - Hide the Mode field in the Create Order modal for asymmetric key type, where it has no effect - Add a Download button to the Secret payload section, writing the payload as a .txt, .pem, or .bin file based on its content type
  • b3547d8: Floating IP fixes and improvements for second go-live
- Gate the floating IP list-row actions by permission, mirroring the details page: Edit Description, Attach, Detach and Release are hidden when the user lacks the matching permission, so a view-only user is left with just "Show Details" - Connect the DNS Domain and DNS Name fields: entering one requires the other, validated live so the Allocate button reflects the error immediately - Validate the DNS Name as a single hostname label (letters, digits and hyphens, not leading/trailing), with error precedence of required → format → length, and a clearer helptext explaining it is combined with the DNS domain to form the full record - Add a "None" option to the DNS Domain select so the selection can be cleared back to the placeholder - Disable the Allocate button whenever any field (required or optional) has a validation error, or while a server error from a previous attempt is present - Let the user clear a failed-allocation server error by editing any field, instead of only by closing the modal (which lost their input) - Surface Neutron's own reason on a failed allocation (400) instead of a generic message, so the user sees why the request was rejected - Show the floating IP status as plain text in Title Case (Active / Down / Error) and remove the status icons in the list and details views - Use a consistent - - empty-state placeholder (replacing the em dash) across the details view - Refine field wording: shorten the list search placeholder to "Search…", and update help text, validation messages and field placeholders - Give the Description textarea a visible label - Keep the page title as a single top-level h1 on the floating IP service and stop embedding the resource instance name in the modal title - Expose createPermissionRouter and its ServicePolicyConfig, PolicyMapping and EngineDef types from @cobaltcore-dev/aurora/server for package consumers
  • 4a09880: - Add a read-only Instances section under Compute for listing and inspecting Nova servers
- Instances list with a Power State column, filters for power state and availability zone, and a free-text search that matches name, id, flavor, image id, created and IP - Instance detail view with a two-column layout, metadata, tags in the general data, and a per-network Addresses sub-section - Link the flavor name to the flavor detail, and resolve the image name to a link to the image detail; in the list, when the image is not accessible in the project the column shows "- -" instead of a dead link. The detail view shows the image name (linked when resolvable) and the raw image id (copyable) as separate rows. Add an Instances landing-page card. The Metadata section is hidden when the instance has no metadata - Show "Booted from volume" for volume-booted instances instead of an empty image id - Capture Nova namespaced address keys (MAC, type), request a supported servers microversion (never above the deployment max), and follow servers_links pagination; surface Nova errors and truncated/invalid responses instead of a misleading empty list - Gate the Instances nav entry and routes on the compute/nova service catalog
  • a49163c: Resolve Dependabot security advisories via pnpm overrides:
- glob: force patched >=14.0.2 (fixes AbortSignal cancellation bypass allowing post-timeout filesystem traversal, GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4), pulled in transitively through @fastify/static - minimatch: force patched >=11.0.1 (fixes potential denial of service via globparts amplification, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249)
  • f60d56b: - Security Group detail tabs use Juno TabBar/TabBarItem instead of the deprecated TabNavigation.
- Security Groups list, Rules and RBAC Policies empty states use title-case titles and distinguish "no data" from "no search/filter matches". - The Security Groups list, Rules and RBAC Policies searches show a generic "Search..." placeholder. - The Delete Security Group modal names the group in its body instead of its title. - Name and description errors in the Create/Edit Security Group and Add Rule modals appear as soon as they disable the confirm button; Edit can't be saved without changes. - Empty values in Security Groups (General Information, the rules table and the list) show the shared "- -" placeholder instead of "—". - The Add Rule modal shows Direction, Protocol, Port Range and ICMP as titled sections and groups the remote type, the remote CIDR / Security Group and IP Version under one "Remote" section, with a divider before Description.
  • adba9d7: - Normalize the casing of the Instances Power State and Images Status labels so both read as "Running" / "Active" instead of "RUNNING" / "active" (new shared StatusLabel component)

item.title: open-component-model/open-component-model - OCM 0.24.0-rc.2
item.description:
[0.24.0-rc.2] - 2026-11-12

🚀 Features

  • (git) Warn when uploading a tag into a branchless repository (#4106)
  • (perf) Add trigger to the performance suite run (#4140)
  • (config) Add configurable RemotePolicy (#4147)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • (ctf) Handle OCM v1 storage compatibility (#3962)
  • (oci) Accept resources excluded from signature on upload (#4164)
  • (git) [breaking] Disallow local file references in git access (#4151)
  • (oci) [breaking] Bind RemotePolicyAlways cache hits to the repository (#4169)
  • (controller) Don't key deployer cache on excluded digests (#4175)

📦 Dependencies

  • (deps) Update module github.com/shirou/gopsutil/v4 to v4.26.9 (#4123)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/moby/moby/api to v1.56.1 (#4120)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/go-git/go-billy/v6 to v6.0.0-beta.1 (#4119)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/pb33f/go-yaml to v0.1.1 (#4122)
  • (deps) Update module sigs.k8s.io/kustomize/api to v0.21.2 (#4125)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/docker/cli to v29.8.2+incompatible (#4129)
  • (deps) Update module go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp to v0.72.0 (#4133)
  • (deps) Update module sigs.k8s.io/release-utils to v0.12.5 (#4131)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/pjbgf/sha1cd to v0.7.0 (#4132)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 to v1.114.0 (#4135)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/prometheus/common to v0.72.0 (#4136)
  • (deps) Update module github.com/moby/moby/client to v0.6.1 (#4121)
  • (deps) Update module go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp to v1.11.1 (#4124)
  • (deps) Update ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller:latest docker digest to 8dc6df0 (#4117)
  • (deps) Update module sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime to v0.25.2 (#4130)
  • (deps) Update digest pins (#4116)
  • (deps) Update dependency sigstore/scaffolding to v0.7.38 (#4170)
  • (deps) Bump klauspost/compress and Go toolchain for CVEs (#4217) (#4225)

⚡ Performance

  • (oci) Hash pushed blobs only where nothing else verifies them (#4081)

🧪 Testing

  • (oci) Verify legacy docker images on Nexus hosted repositories (#4154)

⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks

  • Refactor Repository to CachedStore (#3918)
  • (tests) Bump kro and use aggregation rbac mode (#4172)

Get This Release

Install the OCM CLI

``bash
curl -sfL https://ocm.software/install-cli.sh | OCM_VERSION=0.24.0-rc.2 bash
`

For alternative installation options, see the installation guide.

You can also run the OCM CLI in a container without installing it:

`bash
docker run --rm -t ghcr.io/open-component-model/cli:0.24.0-rc.2 --help
`

See the container image guide for more details.

Deploy the OCM Controller

Install into a Kubernetes cluster via Helm:

`bash
helm install ocm-k8s-toolkit oci://ghcr.io/open-component-model/kubernetes/controller/chart \
--version 0.24.0-rc.2 \
--namespace ocm-k8s-toolkit-system \
--create-namespace
`

See the controller setup guide for full configuration options.

OCM Component Distribution (for existing OCM users)

Every OCM release is published as OCM component versions to ghcr.io/open-component-model - the same distribution mechanism OCM enables for your own software. Components in this release:

| Component | Contents |
|---|---|
| ocm.software/ocm:0.24.0-rc.2 | Product wrapper referencing CLI + controller |
| ocm.software/cli:0.24.0-rc.2 | CLI binaries and OCI image |
| ocm.software/kubernetes/controller:0.24.0-rc.2 | Controller image and Helm chart |

Inspect the full product component:

`bash
ocm get component-version ghcr.io/open-component-model//ocm.software/ocm:0.24.0-rc.2 -o yaml
`

Download a CLI binary directly via OCM (requires OCM CLI already installed; replace os and architecture as needed — e.g. linux/amd64, darwin/arm64):

`bash
ocm download resource ghcr.io/open-component-model//ocm.software/cli:0.24.0-rc.2 \
--identity os=linux,architecture=amd64
``

Community & Contributors

This release we had a total of 7 contributors!
If you want to engage with us, check our community page!

Note

⚠️ GPU pods on gVisor fail to start with the gardenlinux-nvidia-installer v1.26.0, which ships NVIDIA driver 615.71.10. The bundled gVisor (release-20261102.0) supports nvproxy driver versions only up to 615.71.09, so the sentry aborts at startup with unsupported Nvidia driver version: 615.71.10 (surfaced as a pod sandbox creation error). The previous installer v1.24.0 (NVIDIA driver 610.x) works. To unblock, pin the gardenlinux-nvidia-installer to v1.24.0

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-shoot-networking-filter - v0.31.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-shoot-networking-filter:v0.31.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] The gardener-runtime-networking-filter Helm chart and image are no longer published. by @axel7born [#461]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] Add decompression limit and entry-count/CIDR validation to Secret-sourced filter lists. by @axel7born [#459]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] - Fixed a data race between the background filter-list refresh goroutine and concurrent reconcile workers. GetFilterList() now returns a defensive copy and is protected by a sync.RWMutex, preventing concurrent reconciles from mixing filter entries across shoots.
- Removed the unconditional networking.gardener.cloud/to-private-networks: allowed label from both deployment templates. to-public-networks: allowed in the extension chart is now conditional on egressFilter.filterListProviderType: download. by @axel7born [#462]

item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-shoot-dns-service:v1.96.0]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] ⚠️ This extension no longer supports Kubernetes versions <= 1.32. Please make sure to upgrade all Garden, Seed and Shoot clusters to at least version 1.33 before deploying this extension version. by @ary1992 [#871]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Use more specific podSelector in NextGen in-cluster DNS network policy by @MartinWeindel [#874]

[github.com/gardener/external-dns-management:v0.55.0]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Use direct API if shadowing by wildcard entry detected. by @MartinWeindel [#1222]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Retry Route53 Create as Upsert action when record exists but differs by @MartinWeindel [#1214]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Fix domain fallback for excluded forwarded child zone by @MartinWeindel [#1209]
  • [OPERATOR] Fixed a nil-pointer panic in GCP workload-identity DNSProvider validation on an unparseable token_url or service_account_impersonation_url. by @Vincinator [#1191]
  • [OPERATOR] The Istio gateway source now re-triggers all gateways that share a target service or ingress, so that their DNS entries follow load balancer address changes. by @RaphaelFakhri [#1213]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Fix: calculate forwarded domains between same-visibility private zones by @MartinWeindel [#1208]

item.title: openmcp-project/controller-utils - Release v0.34.0
item.description:
Changelog

🚀 Features

#### [DEVELOPER]

  • The new library at pkg/periodic allows to construct a Periodic, which can execute a given function at defined intervals (initially designed for building garbage collectors). The instance can be passed into controller-runtime's Manager for simple lifecycle management. (#305, @Diaphteiros)
  • Add opt-in OTLP/gRPC log export and explicit OpenTelemetry SDK metadata helpers to the shared logging library. (#312, @MichaelSp)

item.title: gardener/external-dns-management - v0.55.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/external-dns-management:v0.55.0]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Use direct API if shadowing by wildcard entry detected. by @MartinWeindel [#1222]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Retry Route53 Create as Upsert action when record exists but differs by @MartinWeindel [#1214]
  • [OPERATOR] [next-generation] Fix domain fallback for excluded forwarded child zone by @MartinWeindel [#1209]
  • [OPERATOR] Fixed a nil-pointer panic in GCP workload-identity DNSProvider validation on an unparseable token_url or service_account_impersonation_url. by @Vincinator [#1191]
  • [OPERATOR] The Istio gateway source now re-triggers all gateways that share a target service or ingress, so that their DNS entries follow load balancer address changes. by @RaphaelFakhri [#1213]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Fix: calculate forwarded domains between same-visibility private zones by @MartinWeindel [#1208]

item.title: open-component-model/ocm-setup-action - v2.0.0
item.description:
⚠️ Breaking

The action now installs the OCM v2 CLI from open-component-model/open-component-model. Workflows that need the legacy OCM v1 CLI must reference open-component-model/ocm-setup-action@v1 (v1.1.0). See Migrating from v1.

Features

  • Linux, macOS, Windows on x64 and arm64
  • Verifies the release asset SHA-256 digest and the build provenance attestation (verify-attestation, default true)
  • Caches the binary with actions/cache (cache, default true)
  • latest resolves to the highest stable semver release
  • New outputs: version, path, cache-hit
``yaml
  • uses: open-component-model/ocm-setup-action@v2
with: version: 0.23.0
  • run: ocm version
`` Full Changelog: https://github.com/open-component-model/ocm-setup-action/compare/v1.1.0...v2.0.0 (#27)

item.title: open-resource-discovery/specification - v1.17.1
item.description:
What's new?

Changed

  • Removed the requirement for case-insensitive ORD ID comparison, lookup and deduplication.
  • Allowed different resource visibility levels within the same Package under SAP Core. Resources and their definitions remain subject to their individual visibility rules.
  • Documented oas-overlay-v1 as a valid API Resource definition type for the odata-v2, odata-v4, and rest protocols, aligning the protocol definition-type lists with the OpenAPI Overlay support added in 1.17.0.

Added

  • Added optional correlationIds to Vendors to correlate a vendor with identifiers in external systems using the existing ORD Correlation ID format.
  • Added Building Materials, Fashion, and Real Estate to the standardized industry values.

------

What's Changed

  • Release v1.17.1 by @Fannon in #246
  • docs(policy): allow mixed package visibility in SAP Core by @nirooxx in #231
  • docs(spec): include OpenAPI overlays in protocol definition-type lists by @nirooxx in #242
  • Add industry taxonomy values by @Shrikant991 in #198
  • Remove case-insensitive ORD ID requirement by @Fannon in #244
  • Add correlationIds to ORD Vendors by @Fannon in #238
  • chore: use shared agent instructions by @Fannon in #237
  • Polish ORD 1.17 guidance and shared diagrams by @Fannon in #226
  • Bundle NotebookLM export into five sources by @Fannon in #222
  • docs: update capability examples for ORD 1.17 by @Fannon in #221
Full Changelog: v1.17.0...v1.17.1

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-provider-alicloud - v1.75.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-provider-alicloud:v1.75.0]

✨ New Features

  • [USER] This extension now supports shoot clusters with Kubernetes version 1.37.
You should consider the Kubernetes release notes before upgrading to 1.37. by @shafeeqes [#953]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Bump gardener to v1.154.0, k8s.io/* to v0.37.1, controller-runtime to v0.25.2, Go to 1.26.8. by @kevin-lacoo [#967]
  • [OPERATOR] quote string fields in machineclass Helm template to prevent YAML parse errors caused by special characters in values by @kevin-lacoo [#960]
  • [OPERATOR] enforce HTTPS scheme for all Alicloud API calls by @kevin-lacoo [#961]
  • [OPERATOR] add csi.enableLabeler field to ControlPlaneConfig. When true, node-side DaemonSet runs without Alicloud
credentials via labeler. Default behavior unchanged. by @kevin-lacoo [#957]
  • [OPERATOR] Update CSI sidecar images and bump csi-plugin-alicloud to v1.37.3. by @kevin-lacoo [#966]
  • [OPERATOR] update alibaba-cloud-sdk-go to v1.63.107 and aliyun-oss-go-sdk to v3.0.2+incompatible by @kevin-lacoo [#947]
  • [OPERATOR] ⚠️ This extension no longer supports Kubernetes versions <= 1.32. Please make sure to upgrade all Garden, Seed and Shoot clusters to at least version 1.33 before deploying this extension version. by @ary1992 [#965]

item.title: gardener/etcd-druid - unnamed-release
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/etcd-druid:v0.39.2]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] The runtime base image has been changed from distroless/static-debian12 to distroless/static-debian13. The CA bundle no longer contains the emSign ECC Root CA - G3 and AAA Certificate Services roots, whose eMudhra intermediate CA keys are compromised. by @Perseus985 [#1466]

[github.com/gardener/etcd-wrapper:v0.8.4]

📰 Noteworthy

item.title: cobaltcore-dev/openstack-hypervisor-operator - v1.4.0 interface-aware certificates
item.description:
v1.4.0

Interface-aware node certificates, server-side apply across controllers, and fixes
for chart credentials and the onboarding handover gate.

⚠️ Upgrade notes

  • Certificates now include Calico interface addresses. New flags
--certificate-interface-include-regex (default ^vlan_[0-9]+$) and --certificate-interface-exclude-regex (default empty, wins over include), exposed in Helm as controllerManager.manager.env.certificateInterfaceIncludeRegex / certificateInterfaceExcludeRegex. Empty include admits all interfaces; invalid regexes prevent startup.
  • Certificate addresses are filtered to unzoned global-unicast IPs. Loopback,
link-local, multicast, and zoned addresses are dropped, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are canonicalised. Review certificates if you relied on such an address.

New features

Interface IPs in node certificates

Certificates previously covered only Node status addresses, so connections over
additional interfaces (for example Calico-reported VLANs) failed TLS validation.
Matching addresses from the projectcalico.org/Interfaces annotation are now
merged in and deduplicated. The exclude regex wins over the include regex.

The controller applies the full Certificate spec on every Node event, so address
changes trigger reissuance by cert-manager.

Bug fixes

Chart no longer renders an empty OS_USERNAME

The chart previously rendered OS_USERNAME from values, producing an empty
environment variable when unset. The username now comes from SERVICE_USERNAME
in the chart secret, alongside the password, and rendering fails when neither
secret.serviceUsername nor controllerManager.manager.env.osUsername is set.

TraitsUpdated is set when custom traits are already in sync

Reconcile returned early when the desired and recorded custom traits matched,
without setting TraitsUpdated. Since that condition gates handover, hypervisors
without custom traits could never finish onboarding. The controller now reports
success from the recorded state, compares traits order-insensitively, queries
placement only when spec and status diverge, and removes stray traits in one pass.

Internals

  • OnboardingController, TraitsController, and Certificate creation migrated to
server-side apply. Seeding only claims conditions owned by each controller.
  • Nova ID lookup and initial conditions are applied in one pass, avoiding SSA
pruning of IDs owned by a single field manager.
  • Certificate creation drops the retry-on-conflict loop and re-applies the full
spec on each reconcile.

Dependencies & tooling

  • Go 1.27.2 → 1.27.3; k8s.io/* 0.37.1 → 0.37.2; cert-manager v1.21.2 → v1.21.3
  • prometheus/common v0.72.1 → v0.73.0
  • Security: golang.org/x/net v0.61.0 → v0.62.0
  • golangci-lint v2.14.0 → v2.15.0; CI actions refreshed; Renovate
minimumReleaseAge set to 3 days

Full Changelog: https://github.com/cobaltcore-dev/openstack-hypervisor-operator/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0

item.description:

item.title: open-resource-discovery/spec-toolkit - v0.10.0
item.description:
• new feature: support object-level oneOf with required-only entries, expressing an "exactly one of these (groups of) properties must be present" constraint. A branch may require several properties together. Accepted in strict mode and rendered in the documentation as _Exactly one of the following properties must be present: ..._ when every branch is a single property, or _Exactly one of the following must be satisfied: a or (b and c)._ when a branch groups several properties. Mirrors the existing anyOf ("at least one of") support.
  • fix: escape pipe characters in Markdown content rendered inside property table cells, preventing malformed tables and MDX compilation failures.
  • fix: root-level schema examples are validated and rendered once in the dedicated Complete Examples section (#115).
  • fix: consecutive generation runs in one process use isolated validation and plugin configuration state, and invalid schema examples or defaults throw errors instead of terminating the host process (#112).
  • fix: rebuilding a locally linked checkout preserves an executable CLI entry point.
  • changed: CLI failures are consistently written to standard error.

What's Changed

  • Refactor generation context, logging, and testability by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/spec-toolkit/pull/114
  • Fix re-entrant generation state by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/spec-toolkit/pull/116
  • fix: escape pipes in Markdown table cells by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/spec-toolkit/pull/111
  • feat: support object-level oneOf with required-only entries (exactly-one-of) by @Fannon in https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/spec-toolkit/pull/119
Full Changelog: https://github.com/open-resource-discovery/spec-toolkit/compare/v0.9.1...v0.10.0

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-provider-azure - v1.66.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-provider-azure:v1.66.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] The managed service principal feature has been removed. Operator-provisioned per-tenant Azure service principal secrets (labeled azure.provider.extensions.gardener.cloud/purpose=tenant-service-principal-secret) are no longer read or injected by the cloudprovider webhook. by @hebelsan [#1651]

📰 Noteworthy

  • [DEPENDENCY] The following container images have been updated:
- cloud-controller-manager: v1.37.0 -> v1.37.2 (patch) - cloud-node-manager: v1.37.0 -> v1.37.2 (patch) LoadBalancer Services with invalid Azure annotation values (public IP resource group, internal subnet, or Private Link Service annotations) will now fail to reconcile until corrected. Services listing a managed LB frontend IP in service.beta.kubernetes.io/azure-additional-public-ips are no longer accepted. by @federated-github-access[bot] [#1669]

✨ New Features

  • [USER] This extension now supports shoot clusters with Kubernetes version 1.37.
You should consider the Kubernetes release notes before upgrading to 1.37. by @shafeeqes [#1649]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [OPERATOR] Fixed a false-positive PrometheusHealthCheckDown (scrape:empty) alert for the Azure CSI driver controllers on idle shoots with no volume activity. by @shafeeqes [#1650]
  • [OPERATOR] CSI controller replica count in ha setup by @hebelsan [#1668]
  • [OPERATOR] An issue has been fixed where the azuredisk CSI disk controller could not list/watch nodes, causing forbidden errors. The csi-driver-controller-disk ClusterRole now grants the required permissions. by @shafeeqes [#1647]

🏃 Others

  • [USER] Improved Azure configuration handling and validation by @matthias-horne [#1667]
  • [DEPENDENCY] The following container images have been updated:
- cloud-controller-manager: v1.32.20 -> v1.32.23 (patch) - cloud-controller-manager: v1.33.17 -> v1.33.20 (patch) - cloud-controller-manager: v1.34.13 -> v1.34.16 (patch) - cloud-controller-manager: v1.35.8 -> v1.35.11 (patch) - cloud-controller-manager: v1.36.5 -> v1.36.8 (patch) - cloud-node-manager: v1.32.20 -> v1.32.23 (patch) - cloud-node-manager: v1.33.17 -> v1.33.20 (patch) - cloud-node-manager: v1.34.13 -> v1.34.16 (patch) - cloud-node-manager: v1.35.8 -> v1.35.11 (patch) - cloud-node-manager: v1.36.5 -> v1.36.8 (patch) - csi-driver-disk: v1.34.6 -> v1.36.1 (singleton) - csi-driver-file: v1.35.8 -> v1.35.11 (singleton) - csi-provisioner: v6.3.0 -> v6.4.0 (singleton) - csi-resizer: v2.2.1 -> v2.3.0 (singleton) - csi-snapshot-controller: v8.6.0 -> v8.7.0 (singleton) - csi-snapshotter: v8.6.0 -> v8.7.0 (singleton) by @federated-github-access[bot] [#1640]

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-envoy-gateway - unnamed-release
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-envoy-gateway:v0.2.0]

✨ New Features

  • [USER] Fix the EnvoyProxy confused-deputy escalation by switching to GatewayNamespace deploy mode. Add a NetworkPolicy controller, enabled via manageDataPlaneNetworkPolicies, that reconciles the client → proxy ingress and the proxy's DNS + control-plane egress NetworkPolicies for the data-plane proxies. by @DockToFuture [#37]
  • [USER] Generate random HMAC key. by @DockToFuture [#51]
  • [DEVELOPER] PLATFORM in the Makefile now defaults to the host architecture by @anluerz [#53]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] The envoy-gateway extension no longer blocks shoot deletion when user Gateway objects were not removed first; it now clears the leftover GatewayClass finalizer during teardown. by @DockToFuture [#39]
  • [USER] Open port 10443/TCP in the Envoy proxy NetworkPolicy so HTTPS Gateways are no longer silently blocked. by @DockToFuture [#40]
  • [DEVELOPER] Fix incorrect YAML path for admission image in update-version-tags and deploy-dev-setup.sh. by @anluerz [#52]

item.title: gardener/gardener-extension-auditing - v0.5.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/gardener-extension-auditing:v0.5.0]

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • [OPERATOR] The extension now supports only Gardener installations managed by the Gardener operator, the virtual garden cluster is unconditionally enabled in the helm charts. by @vpnachev [#118]
  • [DEVELOPER] Non-operator local gardener setup has been removed as part of https://github.com/gardener/gardener/issues/11958, now this extension also removed the support for this flavor of local development, i.e. the make targets extension-(up|down|dev) are removed. by @vpnachev [#118]

🏃 Others

  • [OPERATOR] Component binaries are now built with Go 1.26.5 by @dependabot[bot] [#107]
  • [OPERATOR] The update mode of the VerticalPodAutoscaler resources deployed by the gardener-extension-auditing is now explicitly set to InPlaceOrRecreate, reflecting the actual runtime behavior after the unconditional enablement of the VPAInPlaceUpdates feature gate. by @DobromirNPeev [#108]
  • [OPERATOR] Component binaries are now built with golang 1.27.3 by @dependabot[bot] [#123]
  • [OPERATOR] Container base image is now updated to debian13 by @dependabot[bot] [#123]

item.title: gardener/opentelemetry-collector - v0.0.2
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/opentelemetry-collector:v0.0.2]

✨ New Features

  • [OPERATOR] Add config validations for Kubeconfig and Namespace in Gardener receiver by @chrkl [#64]
  • [OPERATOR] Add Gardener metrics receiver by @chrkl [#23]
  • [USER] Collect metrics for Shoot and Seed constraints in gardenerreceiver by @hammadzf [#122]
  • [USER] Adjust to Gardener API deprecations by @chrkl [#25]
  • [USER] Introduce a new extension that integrates the OpenTelemetry Collector with the sd_notify protocol. by @iypetrov [#32]
  • [USER] Optimize informer cache usage by removing unnecessary attributes from cached objects by @chrkl [#24]
  • [USER] Updated all components, removed Loki exporter, and included the pprofextension component. by @rrhubenov [#19]
  • [USER] Adds WATCHDOG=1 keep-alive support to the sdnotify extension so systemd can detect and restart a unhealthy collector. by @iypetrov [#52]
  • [USER] Refactor condition metrics to reduce cardinality by @chrkl [#73]
  • [USER] Add business-critical attribute to shoot metrics by @chrkl [#119]
  • [USER] Fixes a bug where the sdnotify extension emitted STOPPING=1 during a Type=notify-reload in-process reload, which caused systemd to flip the unit into deactivating mid-reload and stall the entire reload cycle. by @iypetrov [#54]
  • [USER] Switch sdnotify extension to upstream version by @chrkl [#105]
  • [DEVELOPER] Add Gardener Receiver e2e test by @chrkl [#67]
  • [DEVELOPER] Add Renovate grouping for Gardener dependencies by @chrkl [#44]
  • [DEVELOPER] Add kind/enhancement label to renovate pull requests by @chrkl [#31]
  • [DEVELOPER] Run Gardener receiver e2e tests for PR validation by @chrkl [#134]
  • [DEVELOPER] Group Go version updates across Docker and Actions for renovate PRs by @chrkl [#82]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] Send STOPPING=1 reliably on shutdown. by @iypetrov [#70]
  • [DEVELOPER] Fix gardenerreceiver e2e test by @chrkl [#128]
  • [DEVELOPER] Fix using PromQL client in e2e tests by @chrkl [#124]

🏃 Others

  • [DEVELOPER] Switch from Dependabot to Renovate by @chrkl [#27]

📖 Documentation

  • [USER] Add documentation for Gardener metrics receiver by @chrkl [#61]

item.title: konfidence-project/konfidence - 0.1.0-alpha.1
item.description:
Welcome to Konfidence

Konfidence 0.1.0-alpha.1 is the first alpha release of Konfidence. Konfidence packages multi-component applications as immutable vectors and promotes them across stages on Kubernetes. This release contains the operators, the API server with its dashboard, and the kden CLI.

This is an alpha release, and some parts don't work yet

Expect rough edges. Some features are incomplete, and some may not work at all. APIs, custom resources, and CLI commands can change between alpha releases without a migration path. Don't run this release in production.

We improve quality with every release from here on

We keep working on the quality of Konfidence release by release. The bugs you report decide what we fix first. The changelog below lists everything that changed since 0.0.1-alpha.1.

New contributors are welcome

Try Konfidence and tell us what breaks. Questions, bug reports, and pull requests of any size are welcome.
  • Start with the Quickstart Guide.
  • Report bugs and gaps in GitHub issues.
  • Open a pull request for any fix.

item.description:
Welcome to Konfidence

Konfidence 0.1.0-alpha.1 is the first alpha release of Konfidence. Konfidence packages multi-component applications as immutable vectors and promotes them across stages on Kubernetes. This release contains the operators, the API server with its dashboard, and the kden CLI.

This is an alpha release, and some parts don't work yet

Expect rough edges. Some features are incomplete, and some may not work at all. APIs, custom resources, and CLI commands can change between alpha releases without a migration path. Don't run this release in production.

We improve quality with every release from here on

We keep working on the quality of Konfidence release by release. The bugs you report decide what we fix first. The changelog below lists everything that changed since 0.0.1-alpha.1.

New contributors are welcome

Try Konfidence and tell us what breaks. Questions, bug reports, and pull requests of any size are welcome.
  • Start with the Quickstart Guide.
  • Report bugs and gaps in GitHub issues.
  • Open a pull request for any fix.

item.title: open-resource-discovery/overlay-editor - v0.2.3
item.description:
What's new?

Changed

  • Bumped to @open-resource-discovery/ui-components@^0.2.0. The library now ships its own .ord-ui-scoped element reset and Tailwind preflight at specificity (0,1,0), which beats Infima's unlayered (0,0,1) selectors outright. As a result, the consumer-side workarounds that were previously needed are removed:
- The hand-rolled .overlay-root-scoped preflight in src/lib/styles.css is deleted — the overlay is rendered inside .ord-ui, so the library's reset covers it. - The Infima-bleed neutralization block in website/src/css/custom.css (the :where(.ord-ui) p/h1…h6/ul/ol/… margin and font-size resets) is deleted.
  • Fixed the appearance of the left-pane overlay selector: corrected border, padding, and card title font-size by switching to Tailwind important-modifier utilities (border-b!, border-border!, p-2!, text-sm!) so the correct values take precedence over any inherited host styles.
  • Tightened the standalone bundle's CSS scoping in vite.standalone.config.ts: .ord-ui is no longer treated as an already-scoped selector, so ui-components' own .ord-ui-scoped reset and token rules are further prefixed with .overlay-card-view in the standalone bundle. This prevents the globally-loaded bundle from re-applying the element reset to the Docusaurus chrome, which was zeroing Input/Card borders in the playground header.
  • Fixed Vitest crashes when running tests against a symlinked (file:) ui-components dependency: added resolve.dedupe for React and inlined @open-resource-discovery/ui-components and @base-ui/* in vitest.config.ts to force a single React instance and avoid "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useState')" hook errors.

------

What's Changed

  • Feat/upgrade UI components by @aneta-a in #62
  • chore(deps): consolidate Renovate dependency updates by @aneta-a in #55
Full Changelog: rel/0.2.2...rel/0.2.3

item.title: cloudoperators/permission-manager - v0.0.6
item.description:
What's Changed

  • feat(provider/k8s): support deny-driven capability rules via excludeResources by @mik-tsi in https://github.com/cloudoperators/permission-manager/pull/61
  • fix(provider/k8s): prune stale target status after orphan cleanup by @mik-tsi in https://github.com/cloudoperators/permission-manager/pull/63
  • feat(provider/k8s): partial-success apply for ASRs with mixed clusters by @mik-tsi in https://github.com/cloudoperators/permission-manager/pull/64
  • feat(provider/k8s): resolve group versions from discovery cache instead of ServerGroups() by @mik-tsi in https://github.com/cloudoperators/permission-manager/pull/65
  • feat(utils): resolve remote cluster config via greenhouse lifecycle by @abhijith-darshan in https://github.com/cloudoperators/permission-manager/pull/95
Full Changelog: https://github.com/cloudoperators/permission-manager/compare/v0.0.5...v0.0.6

item.title: open-resource-discovery/github-release - v0.1.0
item.description:
What's new?

Added

  • Added automated GitHub release creation.
  • Added changelog-based release notes.
  • Added configurable tag templates and release metadata.
  • Added contributor detection and GitHub-native mentions.
  • Added optional CI workflow dispatch for generated changelog PRs.

------

What's Changed

  • feat: add What's new? heading to release body before changelog content by test-actor in 5710120
  • fix: prevent dry-run from calling real GitHub API when release already exists by test-actor in 37f366d
  • chore: update changelog for version 0.1.0 in #194
  • fix: correct prettier formatting in updateChangelog output and test by test-actor in 5a48097
  • fix: prevent leading blank lines in generated CHANGELOG.md when no header precedes [unreleased] by test-actor in 5372dc6
  • docs: expand README with motivation, inputs/outputs, and clean up release workflow by test-actor in 71fc1b3
  • chore: npx prettier write . by test-actor in 2192ef7
  • docs: Add Inputs section to README by test-actor in b882d2e
  • docs: add required permissions to README and improve git.ts branch coverage by @nirooxx in #191
  • feat: migrate GitHub release action to TypeScript and modernize release flow by @nirooxx in #168
  • chore(deps): update linting tools in #190

item.title: gardener/coredns-config-adapter - v0.7.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/coredns-config-adapter:v0.7.0]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] Custom CoreDNS server blocks that reference plugins not compiled into node-local-dns (e.g. file, ready, kubernetes) no longer crash-loop node-local-dns; the adapter rewrites them to forward to the in-cluster CoreDNS instead. Tokens containing whitespace (notably the template plugin's quoted answer argument) are now re-quoted so the regenerated Corefile parses back identically. by @DockToFuture [#29]

item.title: open-resource-discovery/global-registry-bot - v0.1.9
item.description:
Request Bot Core Refactor and Webhook Reliability

  • Refactored the request handler into event, runtime, composition, and infrastructure layers.
  • Reduced the main request orchestrator by moving runtime wiring into dedicated composition modules.
  • Added async webhook dispatch so GitHub webhooks are acknowledged quickly while heavy bot work continues in the background.
  • Preserved existing bot behavior, event flow, callback contracts, and log messages.

item.title: open-resource-discovery/pr-preview-action - v0.0.1
item.description:
Added

  • Added internal QR code generation for PR preview links using vendored segno.
  • Added QR PNG deployment alongside the preview output.
  • Added asset reachability checks before posting the PR preview comment.
  • Added cache-busted QR image URLs to avoid stale or broken image rendering.

Changed

  • Replaced the external QR provider with fully local QR generation.
  • QR codes are now enabled by default without sending preview URLs to third-party services.
  • PR comments now use the validated QR image URL after preview deployment.

Security

  • Removed third-party QR provider usage to prevent preview URL leakage.
  • Reduced MITM, tracking, and external service dependency risks for QR generation.

Commits

  • 609e619 Merge pull request #7 from open-resource-discovery/feat/internal-qr-generation (Nangiale Shir)
  • a448498 Update README + prettier check . (Shir)
  • f8bb793 Added CHANGELOG, package version, github-release and Updated gitignore (Shir)
  • 74fc0cb use repo raw image URL for QR comments on GHES (Shir)
  • 3b8720d replace blocked health check action with github-script (Shir)
  • 16c5cca replace custom wait logic with URL health check action (Shir)
  • 89ee659 handle compressed QR responses in asset validation (Shir)
  • e106946 check QR asset without cache buster before commenting (Shir)
  • 819d083 refine QR polling with backoff and separate wait settings (Shir)
  • 4cf7f78 make QR validation best effort after preview check (Shir)
  • c2f9f66 fix: replace heredoc with python -c one-liner to fix YAML parse error (Shir)
  • 7b22008 improve preview wait logic with initial delay and asset validation (Shir)
  • 8061330 fix: add cache-busting and longer wait for QR preview assets (Shir)
  • 1ce8bd6 fix: wait for preview asset before posting PR comment (Shir)
  • 05dca12 fix: avoid underscore-prefixed QR asset name for GitHub Pages (Shir)
  • 3a01693 fix: generate QR code as real PNG instead of SVG (Shir)
  • 288ab9c fix: render PR preview QR code as PNG instead of SVG (Shir)
  • 431ce17 feat: add internal QR code generation using segno (Shir)
  • 2e458a6 Merge pull request #6 from open-resource-discovery/fix/artifact-upload-ghes-github-compat (Nangiale Shir)
  • 73d0fab fix: replace deprecated artifact v3 usage with GHES-compatible upload fallback (Shir)
  • d2fdb6d fix: support artifact upload on both GitHub.com and GHES (Shir)
  • 3fe176f Merge pull request #5 from open-resource-discovery/fix/ghes-artifact-upload (Nangiale Shir)
  • 822a165 fix: use GHES-compatible artifact upload for fork previews (Shir)
  • d933bcf Merge pull request #4 from open-resource-discovery/fix/disable-default-qr-provider (Nangiale Shir)
  • 4023a0b fix: disable default external QR provider + Update README (Shir)
  • 725b80c Merge pull request #1 from open-resource-discovery/chore/oss-prep (Nangiale)
  • 641d0df fix: bump upload artifact to v4 (Shir)
  • 69da2f5 chore(oss): initial import from internal prep branch (Shir)
  • 08886cb first commit (Shir)

item.title: platform-mesh/ocm - 0.3.0
item.description:
Platform Mesh 0.3.0

This release of Platform Mesh includes updates to multiple components.

Summary

This release includes 17 component update(s).

Contributors

Thank you to all the contributors who made this release possible: <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/97069709?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="OlegErshov" title="OlegErshov">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/150045440?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="Perseus985" title="Perseus985">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/117839500?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="Sobyt483" title="Sobyt483">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/42006873?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="aaronschweig" title="aaronschweig">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/211480?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="akafazov" title="akafazov">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/7794387?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="gkrajniak" title="gkrajniak">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/188569921?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="iakmc" title="iakmc">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/15053826?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="makdeniss" title="makdeniss">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/1658560?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="mirzakopic" title="mirzakopic">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/3225744?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="mjudeikis" title="mjudeikis">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/52737?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="nexus49" title="nexus49">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/175827539?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="ogligorov" title="ogligorov">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/253026766?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="philtk79" title="philtk79">  <img src="https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/11369081?v=4" width="50" height="50" alt="simontesar" title="simontesar">   _14 contributor(s)_

Key Changes

  • account-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Removed FGA subroutine. (#141 by @simontesar)
  • account-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Configuration via Viper config files and environment variables has been removed. All configuration is now done via CLI flags (Kubernetes component-base style). (#157 by @makdeniss)
  • account-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Upgraded lifecycle management from golang-commons to subroutines library (#177 by @simontesar)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) The cluster endpoint URL has changed to /api/clusters/{clusterName}/graphql (suffix configurable via --endpoint-suffix). (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) Listener and gateway can now communicate over gRPC (--schema-handler=grpc), enabling independent scaling and deployment of each component. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) Configuration via Viper config files and environment variables has been removed. All configuration is now done via CLI flags (Kubernetes component-base style). (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) CRD ClusterAccess (v1alpha1): spec.auth.secretRef renamed to spec.auth.tokenSecretRef, spec.ca.configMapRef removed, spec.auth.kubeconfigSecretRef simplified to SecretKeyRef, spec.auth.clientCertificateRef changed to corev1.SecretReference. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) CRD ClusterAccess (v1alpha1): spec.host is now optional when kubeconfigSecretRef auth is used, status.observedPath field removed, new fields spec.introspectionPath and spec.requestPathTemplate added. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • kubernetes-graphql-gateway: 🔥 (breaking) New --multicluster-runtime-provider flag with values single, kcp, or multi (default: single). The --enable-kcp flag has been removed in favor of --multicluster-runtime-provider=kcp. (#132 by @aaronschweig)
  • security-operator: 🎉 (feature) Added FGA subroutine as a part of a new account workspaces initializer (#330 by @simontesar)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Configuration via Viper config files and environment variables has been removed. All configuration is now done via CLI flags (Kubernetes component-base style). (#378 by @makdeniss)
  • security-operator: 🎉 (feature) Introduced APIExportPolicy resource and controller for ApiExport binding control (#401 by @OlegErshov)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Used OpenFGA and local cache for getting store ID, removed store ID data from accountInfo resource (#403 by @simontesar)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Moved IdentityProviderConfiguration (IDP) from core.platform-mesh.io to system.platform-mesh.io ApiExport. IDP now is created in :root:orgs workspace instead of organiztion workspace e.g :root:orgs:orgA (#409 by @OlegErshov)
  • security-operator: 🔥 (breaking) Upgraded lifecycle management from golang-commons to subroutines library (#415 by @simontesar)

Component Changes

item.title: gardener/ext-authz-server - v0.3.0
item.description:
[github.com/gardener/ext-authz-server:v0.3.0]

✨ New Features

  • [DEVELOPER] Temporarily support SHA1 ({SHA} prefix) htpasswd format for password verification, alongside bcrypt. This enables backwards compatibility with legacy basic auth secrets until Gardener completes the migration to bcrypt. by @istvanballok [#42]

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • [USER] In combination with Gardener v1.141, monitoring ingress authentication now works for landscapes with pre-June-2024 basic auth secrets that still use SHA1 password hashes. by @istvanballok [#42]

item.title: cobaltcore-dev/lightstack - v0.6.1 - Documentation, Planning & Maintenance
item.description:
What's in this release

v0.6.1 is a documentation and maintenance patch. No code changes, no API changes, no new features. The binary is identical to v0.6.0.

v0.7.0 Planning & Specifications

The v0.7.0 scope has been formally planned through two structured reviews (CEO + Engineering) with independent outside voices. All decisions are captured in:

  • SPEC-006: 7-step execution plan with validation gates
  • ADR-001: Database dependency injection — direct *pgxpool.Pool through constructors (661 refs across 53 files)
  • ADR-002: Rate limiting — golang.org/x/time/rate, two-tier (IP + project-based), 10K entry cap
  • Implementation Plan: 4 phases, 21 tasks with parallelization strategy

Architecture Documentation

  • Rate limiting middleware architecture diagram
  • Dependency injection constructor pattern
  • Full request lifecycle diagram
  • Rate limiting configuration reference (rate_limiting block in o3k.yaml)
  • Updated ROADMAP with concrete v0.7.0 execution sequence

Documentation Cleanup

  • Archived 8 stale/completed files to docs/archive/ (sprints, completed specs, superseded designs)
  • Removed ~10,500 lines of stale content from active documentation
  • Deleted backup files, session artifacts, and agent caches
  • Fixed broken cross-references

Maintenance

  • .gitignore hardened: ignores Claude Code session data, agent artifacts, coverage output
  • Dependency updates: gophercloud v2.12.0, aws-sdk-go-v2 monorepo

Upgrade Notes

No action required. This is a docs-only patch. The binary from v0.6.0 is unchanged.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/cobaltcore-dev/o3k/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1

item.title: ironcore-dev/cluster-api-provider-ironcore-metal - v0.2.0
item.description:
Changes

🚀 Features

  • Add cluster.clusterNetwork to configure APIServerPort @defo89 (#87)
  • Add polling of server claim before setting its ownership to ips @SzymonSAP (#85)
  • Refactor IP address claim labels to use separate name and namespace keys @SzymonSAP (#84)
  • Add owner reference to ipAddressClaims @SzymonSAP (#81)
  • Bump k8s.io/* to v0.32.3 @afritzler (#83)
  • Set OwnerReference to IPAddress @defo89 (#77)
  • Add capi ipam support @SzymonSAP (#67)
  • Rename project to cluster-api-provider-ironcore-metal @hardikdr (#57)
  • Resolve conflicts for CAPI version 1.9.4 upgrade @hardikdr (#55)
  • Bump k8s.io/* deps to v0.31.1 @afritzler (#35)
  • Support setting node Hostname to match Serverclaim name @defo89 (#29)
  • Support ServerSelectors for MetalMachine @hardikdr (#28)
  • Allow Configuring Image for MetalMachines @defo89 (#19)
  • Change dev setup to use Ignition for KubeadmControlPlane @defo89 (#13)
  • Add metal-operator in tilt @defo89 (#12)
  • Implement ServerClaim-handling in MetalMachine Controller @hardikdr (#9)
  • Implement MetalMachine Controller @defo89 (#7)
  • Add Readme @hardikdr (#8)
  • Setup Github Workflows and Automation @defo89 (#2)
  • Fix linters, code-gen and Reuse @hardikdr (#4)
  • Initialize APIs and Controllers with Kubebuilder @defo89 (#3)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • make metaData compliant with Ignition 2.x spec @defo89 (#76)
  • add securityContext to the controller @defo89 (#71)
  • Resolve conflicts for CAPI version 1.9.4 upgrade @hardikdr (#55)
  • Fix ProviderID @hardikdr (#23)
  • Fix ProviderID Format for MetalMachines @hardikdr (#22)
  • Handle Unbound ServerClaims @hardikdr (#15)
  • Fix Docker Build @hardikdr (#6)

🧰 Maintenance

item.title: gardenlinux/FeOS - FeOS 0.5.0
item.description:
FeOS 0.5.0 Release Notes

🚀 Highlights

  • Internal Architecture Improved
- Fully async, lock-free, event-driven approach
  • Testability
- Unit tests - Nested virtualization-based tests
  • Live Upgrade
- Support for FeOS PID1 live upgrade
  • Backend Flexibility
- Pluggable Rust-based backends: - VM-Service: Cloud Hypervisor / Other rust based vmms possible
  • Cloud Hypervisor
- Hard dependency eliminated
  • Host Service
- Enhanced features and improvements

item.title: ironcore-dev/boot-operator - v0.2.0
item.description:
Changes

  • Reuse API update @sap-ospo-bot (#139)
  • Add support for Keppel image registry @defo89 (#134)
  • Support flat OCI Spec image @hardikdr (#133)

🚀 Features

  • Update Docker Publish Workflow @hardikdr (#174)
  • Add bootctl move command @SzymonSAP (#166)
  • Add support for UUID-specific iPXE scripts via /ipxe/\<uuid> @defo89 (#165)
  • Use upstream docs publishing workflow @ushabelgur (#164)
  • Avoid checking architecture while fetching nested OCI digests @hardikdr (#143)
  • Mark ServerBootConfig as Error for OCI images with invalid layer configuration @hardikdr (#142)
  • Fix apigroup in documentation and regenerate CRDs @hardikdr (#129)
  • Adapt Controllers with Updated OCI Image Format @hardikdr (#124)
  • Add Mkdocs-based Documentation and Automated API Reference Documentation Generation @hardikdr (#105)
  • Allow Processing BootConfigs without IgnitionSecRefs and Remove deprecated MachineBootConfig Reconciler @hardikdr (#104)
  • Bump k8s.io/* to v0.31.1 @afritzler (#96)
  • Update cmdline for pxe boot @hardikdr (#95)
  • Add config/dev kustomize @defo89 (#93)
  • Publish linux/arm64 Docker image @defo89 (#92)
  • Support indexing of uppercase SystemUUID search @defo89 (#91)
  • Support indexing of lowercase SystemUUID search @hardikdr (#90)
  • Support multiple ignition formats @hardikdr (#87)
  • Add Documentation for sample UKI Generation @hardikdr (#86)
  • Support IPXE Boot @hardikdr (#83)
  • Add tests for ServerBootconfiguration Controller @hardikdr (#78)
  • Update IgnitionSecretRef to ObjectRef @hardikdr (#74)
  • Add BootConfiguration Controller @hardikdr (#73)
  • Remove IPXE Boot @hardikdr (#68)
  • Support HTTPBoot conversion for ServerBootConfiguration @hardikdr (#62)
  • Support multiple SystemIPs as identifiers for bootconfigs @hardikdr (#59)
  • Improved Logs @hardikdr (#58)
  • Support /httpboot endpoint @hardikdr (#57)
  • Support configuring ipxe-scripts @hardikdr (#56)
  • Support X-Forwarded-For Header for parsing ClientIPs @hardikdr (#50)
  • Implement server to handle the HTTBootConfig @hardikdr (#42)
  • Implement HTTPBootConfig controller @hardikdr (#41)
  • Update APIs for the HTTPBootConfig @hardikdr (#40)
  • Add APIs for the HTTPBoot @hardikdr (#34)
  • Convert ignition to JSON using butane @hardikdr (#27)
  • Add ServerBootConfiguration controller @afritzler (#22)
  • Support default ipxe-script @hardikdr (#20)
  • Implement reverse image proxy @hardikdr (#17)

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Reconcile ServerBootConfig on Ignition Secret update @hardikdr (#145)
  • Update REUSE.toml @hardikdr (#141)
  • Fix apigroup in documentation and regenerate CRDs @hardikdr (#129)
  • Support case-insensitive search for UUIDs @hardikdr (#100)
  • Skip controller name validation @hardikdr (#97)
  • Update ipxe script template @hardikdr (#64)
  • Update default ipxe script template @hardikdr (#63)
  • Fix error handling in ipxe boot server @hardikdr (#43)
  • Fix Server RBAC @afritzler (#35)
  • Fix RBAC @hardikdr (#18)
